assistant.title: AI Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Your copilot for account context, commission forecasting, and next-best actions.
assistant.welcomeHeading: Ask anything about your book of business
assistant.welcomeBody: Use prompts to simulate real workflows: summarization, risk detection, and suggestions based on emails + CRM data.

suggestedPrompts.label: Summarize key risks and opportunities this week.
What are my top 3 next best actions?

sampleResponse.query: Which accounts need attention this week?
sampleResponse.summary: 3 accounts need follow-up based on email sentiment shifts and stalled CRM activity.
flags: Globex: no reply for 9 days after pricing email
Initech: close date moved twice in 2 weeks
Umbrella: renewal in 18 days with unresolved legal redlines
suggestions: Send a focused pricing clarification to Globex today
Schedule a manager-assisted call for Initech this week
Create a legal unblock task for Umbrella and tag owner

Recover scope through phased packaging option
Prioritize mid-market fast-close deals to offset variance
